title: Orbit 2022 — Art Programme
excerpt: Curating the art programme for Orbit Festival 2022 — SouRCe, re:gen and c55h72mgn4o5, presented by Uncloud.
description:
For the 2022 edition of Orbit Festival I curated the art programme, presented by Uncloud. Three installations were brought into the festival grounds: SouRCe by Emanuel Nijkerk & Victor Dissel, re:gen by Skander Jaïbi & Cris Molle, and c55h72mgn4o5 by Timo Hoogland.
> Rather than designing the light myself that year, my work was the selection and the staging — choosing works that would hold their own among the trees and the crowd, and placing each so it found its own space in the festival.
credits: Curator: Jaco Schilp, for Uncloud. Works: SouRCe — Emanuel Nijkerk & Victor Dissel; re:gen — Skander Jaïbi & Cris Molle; c55h72mgn4o5 — Timo Hoogland. Presented at Orbit Festival 2022. Photography: Ines Kooli.
